messages:
sophia: Quick sync  we need to finalize run-of-show + fallback lanes for the June webinar. goal: zero audible pauses and clear CTA routing.
devin: +1. I'm updating the demo deck to include a short checklist for hot-swap (2 slides).
aisha: Timeline question  are we keeping 45m total or expanding to 60 for extra Q&A?
sophia: Let's keep 45m. We can offer a post-webinar office hours slot for longer Qs.
marco: For the quantization section I recommend a 3-min recorded clip and a 5-min live Q&A so we avoid heavy runtime tuning live.
priya: I can present use-case stories and customer ROI bullets. If I'm delayed, who's the backup?
devin: I can cover Priya's slot if needed; I'll need the one-pager by noon.
ops-bot: Rehearsal blocks created: Wed 10:00 PT (full run), Fri 08:00 PT (tech dry-run). Hosts must RSVP.
aisha: MC/transition plan? need a single voice to call next speakers and push polls.
sophia: I'll MC. Aisha will moderate audience questions, Devin owns demos, Marco handles recorded clip + fallback.
marco: I'll export the clip as mp4 + webm and put on /drive/marketing/backups. will also make 240p copy for flaky connection.
priya: Can we add a poll to gauge interest (Hosted | Dedicated | Private) and map to lead tags?
sophia: Yes. Poll scheduled at 20:00 into the session. CRM mapping: poll->utm_campaign + "interest" property. marketing-ops to confirm webhook.
devin: Also propose an in-chat benchmark card (short bullets + link). attendees should be able to click to the full benchmark report.
aisha: Routing rule: attendees who click benchmark and choose "Private" get routed to AE follow-up; others get nurture sequence.
ops-bot: Confirmed: webhook for poll -> CRM mapping set. backup webhook: crm-hook-backup.redwood/internal.
marco: Run-of-show draft: 0:00 Intro (sophia) \u00B7 5:00 Why latency/cost matter (aisha) \u00B7 12:00 Benchmarks highlight (devin) \u00B7 18:00 Live demo: routing/failover (devin) \u00B7 28:00 Recorded deep-dive: quant & perf (marco) \u00B7 36:00 Panel use-cases (priya & team) \u00B7 42:00 Poll + Q&A (aisha) \u00B7 45:00 CTA + wrap (sophia).
sophia: Add a 1-min CTA slide with 3 CTAs: try hosted, request Dedicated trial, schedule Private consult. Links must have UTM.
devin: I'll draft the 2-line demo fallback script: if primary endpoint fails -> switch to hosted-v2 -> display toast + log event. ops, can you validate toast timing?
ops-bot: Yes. Simulation scheduled Wed 10:15 rehearsal: fail primary endpoint, auto-route to hosted-v2. Toast appears within 2s, telemetry logged.
aisha: What about speaker audio backup? who has the audio-only dial-in?
marco: I have PST dial-in + will enable local recording. Priya, record audio on your phone as fallback?
priya: Yep I'll record just-in-case.
sophia: Marketing needs the public abstract + 1-line bios by Tue 12:00 so promo can go out Wed. who will draft?
devin: I'll draft my bio and the demo blurb by tomorrow morning.
aisha: I'll write the headline + abstract and post in #marketing-assets for review.
marco: Ops question: can we pre-stage the backup video URL in the webinar console for one-click play?
ops-bot: Done. backup_video_url pre-staged: https://drive.redwood/marketing/backup-quant.mp4 (ops only). cohost permissions enabled.
sophia: Final ask: anyone with a hard stop (time conflicts) reply now. we'll lock promo once bios + abstract are in. :rocket:
